newsitem.title: BARBADOS: CRICKET-RED STRIPE CUP THIRD DAY SCORES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-RED STRIPE CUP THIRD DAY SCORES.

text.p: Close of play scores on the third day of four-day Red Stripe Cup cricket matches on Saturday:
In Berbice, Guyana: Guyana 281 (Carl Hooper 119, Clayton Lambert 55; Ian Bishop 5-82) and 24-0. Trinidad and Tobago 413 (P.Simmons 116, D.Ganga 54, I.Bishop 50).
In St Catherine, Jamaica: Jamaica 156 and 337-9 declared (M.Ventura 96, J.Adams 73, I.Garrick 50). Leeward Islands 145 (F.Rose 6-63) and 9-1.
